definitions.explanation: Doing something with great care and attention to detail, leaving nothing to chance.

examples.japanese: {念入|ねんい}りに{準備|じゅんび}する。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{念入|ねんい}りに{化粧|けしょう}をしている。
examples.english: She is doing her makeup carefully.

examples.japanese: {出発|しゅっぱつ}{前|まえ}に{荷物|にもつ}を{念入|ねんい}りにチェックした。
examples.english: I checked my luggage thoroughly before departure.

notes:
{念入|ねんい}り is a na-adjective often used adverbially as {念入|ねんい}りに. It conveys the idea of being thorough and leaving no room for oversights.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {念入|ねんい}りに～する (to do something thoroughly/carefully)
- {念入|ねんい}りな～ (a thorough/meticulous...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {念入|ねんい}りに{確認|かくにん}する (to verify carefully)
- {念入|ねんい}りに{掃除|そうじ}する (to clean thoroughly)
- {念入|ねんい}りに{準備|じゅんび}する (to prepare meticulously)
- {念入|ねんい}りな{調査|ちょうさ} (a thorough investigation)

RELATED WORDS:
{丁寧|ていねい} (polite, careful) focuses on politeness and attentiveness. {念入|ねんい}り focuses more on being thorough and not missing anything. {入念|にゅうねん} has the same meaning with reversed kanji order and is slightly more formal.
